text: **Hint 1:** Consider how different types of gradient descent handle updates to the parameters. Think about the size of the data subset used in each update and how that might affect the direction and stability of the updates.\n\n**Hint 2:** Recall that mini-batch gradient descent uses a small, random subset of the data for each update. This randomness can cause the updates to fluctuate, potentially leading to jumps back and forth around the optimal solution.
